capsuleTopic.title: Jesus
capsuleTopic.subtitle: Promise · Jesus Christ · disciples · signs · cross · resurrection · witness · return
capsuleTopic.orientation: Follow Jesus Christ from explicit earlier Scripture anticipation through naming, birth, ministry, relationships, teaching, signs, betrayal, crucifixion, resurrection, ascension, apostolic witness, later memory, and promised return without flattening parallel sources.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Trace how Jesus is named and encountered—and how Christ moves from translated title and confession into the combined identifiers Jesus Christ and Christ Jesus.

payload.description: Trace proclamation, healing, opposition, inclusion, mission, trial, and witness toward Rome.
